cliner.py.summary: Strip ANSI escapes and other terminal noise from ``.log`` files in place.
details: Applies the usual cleanup patterns (colour codes, ``^[`` sequences, ``\r``, shift-in/shift-out characters, repeated spaces) to every ``.log`` file below the current directory. Large files are mapped with :mod:`mmap` and handled by a worker pool; the originals are overwritten.

cliner2.py.summary: Strip ANSI escapes and terminal noise from ``.log`` files in place.
details: A single-process version of :mod:`cliner`: every ``.log`` file found below the current directory is rewritten with the colour codes, carriage returns and other control characters removed and runs of spaces collapsed.

codepener.py.summary: Wrap a CodePen-style HTML fragment in a complete HTML document.
details: Adds the doctype, ``head``, viewport meta tag, stylesheet link (``style.css``), title and script tag (``script.js``) around the snippet. The title defaults to the file name; an existing file is overwritten when no output path is given.

colab1.py.summary: Copy the Colab site-packages into Google Drive as files and zips.
details: Mounts Drive, then copies the top-level files of ``site.getsitepackages()[0]`` to ``MyDrive/wheels`` and packs each top-level package directory into a deflate-compressed ``.zip`` (``.pyc`` files skipped, ``setuptools``/``pip`` excluded). Meant to be pasted into a Colab notebook cell.
colab1.py.usage: python colab1.py   # from a Colab notebook cell
colab1.py.notes: Runs at import time; it needs a Colab runtime because it mounts ``/content/drive``.

collect_env_vars.py.summary: Collect the environment variable names used anywhere below the current directory.
details: Scans every readable file for ``NAME=value`` assignment lines, writes the sorted unique names to ``env_vars.txt`` and prints how many were found.

collectlic.py.summary: Concatenate every license file below a directory into one text file.
details: Recursively collects files whose name contains ``license`` (skipping ``.git``) and writes their contents, separated by blank lines, to ``/sdcard/all2.txt``. Handy for feeding all third-party licenses to a review pass.
collectlic.py.notes: The search starts at the current directory and the output path is fixed at ``/sdcard/all2.txt``.

compile_precise2.py.summary: Generate ``print-style.css``: a print stylesheet with the fonts embedded as base64.
details: Reads ``Inter-Regular.ttf``, ``Inter-Bold.ttf``, ``Inter-Italic.ttf``, ``Inter-BoldItalic.ttf`` and ``JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf`` from the current directory, turns each one into a ``@font-face`` rule with a data URI (falling back to the system fonts when a file is missing) and writes the complete CSS to ``print-style.css``.

compression_benchmark.py.summary: Compare every available compression codec on one file or folder.
details: Runs gzip, bz2, xz, zip, brotli, zstandard, lz4, 7z, lzma, snappy, zopfli, PPMd and deflate64 at several levels (each codec only when its package is installed), prints size/ratio/time for every combination, then copies the smallest result next to the input.

comprust.py.summary: Compress a text file with the LLM-oriented ``Compressor`` prompt helper.
details: Reads the given file, runs ``compression_prompt.Compressor.compress`` over it and writes the result next to the input with a ``.compressed`` suffix.

copy_pyfiles_without_moduledoc.py.summary: Move the Python files that lack a module docstring out of the current directory.
details: Checks whether each top-level ``.py`` file starts with a docstring (scripts with a shebang count as undocumented) and moves the undocumented ones to ``~/tmp/notannotated``.
copy_pyfiles_without_moduledoc.py.notes: Run from the directory to inspect; files are moved, not copied, despite the name.

count_chars.py.summary: Print the number of characters in a text file.
details: Reads the file as UTF-8 and reports ``len(text)``; a missing file prints an error and exits with status 1.

cppnew.py.summary: Create a competitive-programming C++ file from a template and open it in ``$EDITOR``.
details: Writes a skeleton with ``bits/stdc++.h``, fast I/O and an empty ``main`` to the requested path (refusing to overwrite an existing file), then launches the editor named by ``EDITOR`` (``nano`` by default).

cpprun.py.summary: Compile a C or C++ source with clang and run the resulting binary.
details: Picks clang/clang++ (falling back to gcc/g++) based on the extension, compiles with ``-Wall -Wextra -O2`` and ``-std=c17``/``-std=c++17`` into the temporary directory, makes the binary executable and runs it with the remaining arguments, forwarding stdin/stdout/stderr and the exit status.

cppu.py.summary: Reformat C/C++/Java/JS/JSON files in place with ``clang-format``.
details: Runs ``clang-format -i --style=LLVM`` over the files named on the command line, or over the matching extensions below the current directory, in parallel, and reports the size change.
